{{Quote|I'm sorry, Dov. There'd better be a manda for you, some kind of immortality, or there won't be enough revenge in the galaxy for me.|Kal Skirata in his thoughts to Dov|<ref name="True Colors" />}}
'''Dov''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] and bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]<ref name="True Colors" /> sometime after or during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Birth date" /> A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the teen-aged Dov was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during training<ref name="True Colors" /> at some point before [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Dov's [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]] held [[Gender/Legends|himself]] responsible for the [[Commando/Legends|commando's]] death, and he hoped that the dead commando would become a part of [[Manda (religious)|manda]], a collective state of being for all Mandalorian souls upon death. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Skirata named a [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class freighter]] he had purchased ''[[Aay'han]]''&mdash;a word of the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] language that described a particular state of mind&mdash;to honor the memory of Dov.<ref name="True Colors" /> Dov stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Clone Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dov was mentioned in ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2007]].<ref name="True Colors" />
